sections.title: Wine - grape vine
sections.description: Palmate grape leaves, irregular hanging bunches and curled tendrils.

sections.title: Beer - hops and barley
sections.description: Hop bracts and lobed leaves weave into barley heads with long awns.

sections.title: Gin - common juniper
sections.description: Short needle whorls and berry-like seed cones; not generic cedar foliage.

sections.title: American whiskey / bourbon - rye and corn
sections.description: Slender rye heads and corn ears with husks: rye whiskey and the signature grain of bourbon.

sections.title: White oak - leaf and acorn tribute
sections.description: Rounded white-oak lobes and capped acorns, honoring the wood and barrel-aged spirits.
